Error: [2mexpect([22m[31mreceived[39m[2m).[22mtoEqual[2m([22m[32mexpected[39m[2m) // deep equality[22m

[32m- Expected  -  1[39m
[31m+ Received  + 46[39m

[32m- Array [][39m
[31m+ Array [[39m
[31m+   "A tree hydrated but some attributes of the server rendered HTML didn't match the client properties. This won't be patched up. This can happen if a SSR-ed Client Component used:[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ - A server/client branch `if (typeof window !== 'undefined')`.[39m
[31m+ - Variable input such as `Date.now()` or `Math.random()` which changes each time it's called.[39m
[31m+ - Date formatting in a user's locale which doesn't match the server.[39m
[31m+ - External changing data without sending a snapshot of it along with the HTML.[39m
[31m+ - Invalid HTML tag nesting.[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ It can also happen if the client has a browser extension installed which messes with the HTML before React loaded.[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ %s%s https://react.dev/link/hydra
